verses.text: “Hey, I [SYN] have seen everything that you have seen,
What you know, I also know;
But I would like to speak to Almighty God, not to you;
As for you, you do not allow people to know the truth about me,
I wish/desire that you would be silent;
Listen to what I will say to you now;
Are you telling lies about me to prove God is just in causing me to suffer?
Are you trying to defend him?
If he looks closely, will he find that everything that you have done is good?
If you secretly say/do things to cause God to act favorably toward you,
He will certainly [RHQ] cause you to be terrified by his power/greatness;
The things that you say that you think are wise are as useless as [MET] as ashes;
“So, be quiet and allow me to speak,
I am ready to endure anything;
If God kills me, then I will not have anyone else whom I can confidently expect to help me,
No wicked/godless person would dare to stand in the presence of God,
“God, listen very carefully to what I say [DOU].
I am ready to prove that I am innocent,
I certainly do not think [RHQ] that you or anyone else will say that what I say is not true;
“I am requesting you to do two things for me;
The first thing that I request is that you stop punishing [IDM] me;
You speak first, and then I will reply;
What have I done that is wrong? What sins have I committed?
Why ◄do you refuse to be friendly with/have you abandoned► me [IDM]?
I am as insignificant as [MET] a leaf that is blown by the wind;
It seems that you are writing things to accuse me of doing things that are wrong,
It is as though you have fastened my feet with chains to prevent me from walking,
As a result, my body is decaying like [SIM] rotten wood,
